summary: Integra Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 26, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine matters: setting the number of directors at eight, electing eight director nominees (all approved with over 96% support), appointing BDO Canada LLP as auditors (99.99% for), and approving an amended and restated equity incentive plan (98.76% for). The plan is a rolling plan capped at 10% of outstanding shares. This filing is an ordinary routine meeting circular/results report, not a special situation.
